label.text: 1 if the PM10 daily mean on day t+1 is above the 75th percentile of the PM10 daily means of the same calendar month in the three calendar years immediately before the year of t+1 (strictly earlier data only), else 0.

primary_model_note: Features ending in _t1 are ERA5 actuals of the target day, used as a stand-in for a perfect weather forecast. Real forecasts are imperfect, so scores of a model that uses them are an optimistic upper bound.
day_alignment_note: ERA5 days are Europe/Sofia local calendar days; EEA daily values are the daily means as reported by Bulgaria. Both are joined on the calendar date, so the day alignment is approximate.

data_summary.feature_transforms: PM10 and PM2.5 enter as natural logs of the daily mean (ug/m3); precipitation as log(1 + mm); temperature range is daily max minus min.

model.threshold_rule: maximise F1 on the validation rows over thresholds 0.01..0.99

with_next_day_weather.threshold_rule: maximise F1 on the validation rows over thresholds 0.01..0.99

no_next_day_weather.threshold_rule: maximise F1 on the validation rows over thresholds 0.01..0.99

no_weather.threshold_rule: maximise F1 on the validation rows over thresholds 0.01..0.99

live.threshold_rule: maximise F1 on the validation rows over thresholds 0.01..0.99

ablation.note: Features ending in _t1 are ERA5 actuals of the target day, used as a stand-in for a perfect weather forecast. Real forecasts are imperfect, so scores of a model that uses them are an optimistic upper bound.

pm10_only_logreg.threshold_rule: maximise F1 on the validation rows over thresholds 0.01..0.99

monthly_climatology.description: Probability is the share of days in the same calendar month of the previous year that exceed the threshold of the target month (the label threshold).
monthly_climatology.threshold_rule: maximise F1 on the validation rows over thresholds 0.01..0.99

persistence.description: Predicts a bad day tomorrow exactly when today is a bad day by the same label definition (PM10 of day t above the threshold of its own month).

with_next_day_weather.definition: PM10 of day t+1 above 50 ug/m3 (EU daily limit)

no_next_day_weather.definition: PM10 of day t+1 above 50 ug/m3 (EU daily limit)

secondary_label_report.note: Models are trained on the primary label; this only reports how their scores rank days above 50 ug/m3.

provenance.station_filter: Validity == 1 and Value >= 0; Value cast with pd.to_numeric
